sources.title: Introducing MiMo-V2.6 series
sources.evidence: September 22, 2026 research launch explicitly releases and open-sources Pro and Flash, with API/Studio/Desktop availability. Identifies multimodal perception, reasoning and tool use. Video, music and 3D demos involve code and external tools; they are not native generation modalities.

sources.title: MiMo V2.6 models now available on AI Gateway
sources.evidence: September 21, 2026 original provider announcement says exact xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro is now available. Visible date and HTML datePublished agree; midnight metadata is not treated as a measured launch time. Explicitly lists 1.02T/42B, multimodal inputs, reasoning and tools.

sources.title: Xiaomi MiMo Studio changelog
sources.evidence: V3.4.0 entry dated September 21, 2026 explicitly adds mimo-v2.6-pro and Flash dialogue and multimodal visual understanding. Independently corroborates availability one calendar day before the research launch.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
sources.evidence: October 8 first-party report explicitly labels Pro in Table 1: Main Block 1.02T total/42B active, 70 layers (60 SWA/10 global), 384 experts/top-8. Separate encoder counts are 681M vision, 308M audio tokenizer and 127M audio patch. Encoder counts include input embeddings but exclude projectors; audio tokenizer excludes EMA codebooks. Section 2.4 describes a separate five-layer dense DFlash speculative decoder.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL official model card
sources.evidence: Public exact RL checkpoint card at pinned revision has MIT license metadata, nominal 1.02T/42B sparse MoE, 1M context and text/image/video/audio inputs. Public ungated repository was verified through Hugging Face API; its September 21 creation timestamp alone is not evidence of public release.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD official model card
sources.evidence: Public exact MOPD checkpoint identifies itself as the upgrade of Pro-RL. MIT metadata, nominal1.02T/42B, 1M context and the same multimodal architecture/components. Current public ungated MOPD repository was verified through the Hugging Face API.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: max_position_embeddings=1048576; MiMoV2ForCausalLM with 70 layers, one dense and69 MoE,384 experts/top8, separate vision/audio configs, untied embeddings and FP8 quantization metadata. Compared with pinned RL config: non-quantization configuration fields agree.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD chat template
sources.evidence: Explicitly serializes text,image,audio and video inputs, reasoning_content and thinking control, tool definitions, structured tool_calls and tool-response roles. RL tokenizer template independently supports reasoning/tools.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD model implementation
sources.evidence: Vision and audio encoders feed a causal decoder whose lm_head produces text vocabulary logits. Separate audio tokenizer is an input path. Loader ignores model.mtp checkpoint keys; enumerating this implementation alone is incomplete for full checkpoint accounting.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD tensor index
sources.evidence: Read index only:160040 tensor entries in130 files, with mixed weight_scale_inv metadata and model.mtp.layers.0,1,2 in a separate MTP file. No whole weight shards downloaded. Tensor names are not a reconciled learned-parameter inventory.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD DFlash configuration
sources.evidence: Separate DFlashDraftModel has five layers, hidden size6144 and block size8. Distinguish this inference drafter from the three MTP blocks visible in the main checkpoint index. No numeric drafter subtotal inferred.

sources.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Tool-Call Repetition in MiMo-V2.6
sources.evidence: September27 technical post explicitly says updated MOPD checkpoints are open-sourced and API models were updated September25 at06:00UTC+8, retaining names mimo-v2.6-pro and mimo-v2.6-flash. Thus original RL weights and current API revision are not asserted byte-identical.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.6-Pro native model specifications
sources.evidence: Exact native model page states text,image,video,audio input; text output; deep thinking and tool calls;1M context and128K maximum output. Context and output limits are separate.

sources.title: Xiaomi model release changelog
sources.evidence: September22 entry lists exact Pro,Flash andUltraSpeed releases. Records the native release-log date without overriding the earlier September21 provider/Studio availability.

name.note: Public model/API name retained; RL and MOPD are separately downloadable post-training revisions, and UltraSpeed is a separate catalog assignment.

developer.note: Xiaomi MiMo / LLM-Core Xiaomi are the original developer and checkpoint publisher.

release_date.note: Earliest documented public availability: Vercel original announcement and Xiaomi Studio changelog both September21. Xiaomi research launch and model changelog say September22. No precise launch hour or timezone explanation inferred; repository creation and internal research previews do not establish earlier public availability.

open_weights.note: Both exact Pro-RL and Pro-MOPD have public ungated weights; later MOPD publication/update does not reset original model release date.

license.note: MIT is explicitly declared in the official model-card metadata for both weight repositories. No inference from a generic implementation-code license.

parameters_b.note: Author nominal1.02T=1020B, not an exact tensor count. Table1 places this under Main Block and lists separate encoders, so propose language_backbone scope. Encoder figures exclude projectors and audio EMA codebooks; MTP/drafter accounting and rounding are not reconciled. No false complete-system sum or packed-storage count.

active_parameters_b.note: Author nominal42B active in Main Block with eight of384 routed experts. Proposed language_decode scope distinguishes backbone token generation from multimodal encoder work and DFlash speculation; no combined system-wide active count inferred.

architecture.note: Transformer decoder MoE with one dense plus69 MoE layers,60 SWA/10global attention and no shared experts, with vision/audio input encoders. Five-layer DFlash drafter is separate from three original MTP blocks in the main index.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint maximum1,048,576 positions, advertised as1M. Native128K maximum output is a separate constraint.

modalities.note: Exact native model page and checkpoint agree: multimodal understanding, text generation. Tool-created images, videos, MIDI or3D assets do not imply native media output.

reasoning.note: Native deep-thinking capability and checkpoint reasoning-content/thinking-control template support this field.

tool_call.note: Native structured tool calls supported in exact chat template and API page; MOPD revision fixes repetition behavior, not first introduction of tools.

description.value: Multimodal MoE model with text, image, audio and video input, text output, reasoning and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces relative promotional wording with supported input/output and model capabilities.

patch.notes: Public availability is documented on September 21, 2026 by Vercel and Xiaomi Studio; Xiaomi research and model launch pages are dated September 22. Nominal 1.02T/42B counts refer to the language backbone. Separately reported encoders: 681M vision, 308M audio tokenizer and 127M audio patch; these exclude projectors and the tokenizer EMA codebooks. MTP and five-layer DFlash accounting are not reconciled into an exact total. Pro-RL and Pro-MOPD weights are MIT; the native API changed to MOPD on September 25 at 06:00 UTC+8 without changing its model name. Native outputs are text; media-generation demos use external tools.

summary: Verified all14 fields. Adds nominal1020B/42B backbone counts,MoE and MIT; corrects earliest public date toSeptember21 with independent Vercel/Xiaomi Studio evidence. Distinguishes RL/MOPD checkpoints and unchanged API name, multimodal input/text output, separate encoder components and MTP versusDFlash. No exact complete learned-parameter count claimed.
